## 1.3.22 (HexGhoul): holding hands fixed: the hands actually meet now (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.22 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 63**, same as 1.3.21). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- **Hand in hand, redone.** In 1.3.21 the kid's arm stuck straight out sideways across your body and never reached your hand, and a child or teen stood so close it clipped into your arm. Now the kid's arm is aimed at your actual hand, worked out on the real models: a toddler reaches **up** to your hand (its head tipped up at you), a child and a teen reach **down and out** to it and turn their heads to you.
- **The kid walks at the right distance for its age**, far enough out that its body clears your arm.
- **Works for any parent size:** a female player is drawn smaller, so the kid's arm and spacing adjust to her lower hand. If a teen is taller than you, your arm swings out a little to meet theirs.
